categories.name: AI & Automation
categories.meta: Agentic workflows, RAG, MCP, and LLM-powered automation
categories.description: My primary focus: building AI-integrated systems and automations—from RAG assistants on AWS Bedrock to agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, MCP servers, and local LLMs—and using them daily to build, automate, and ship full-stack software.
items: **AI Tools:** Claude Code (terminal-based AI agent), ChatGPT, Cursor
**Agentic Workflows:** Custom agent workflows and multi-step AI automation
**MCP:** Model Context Protocol servers for connecting tools and external integrations to AI agents
**RAG & Cloud LLMs:** Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines with AWS Bedrock (Claude) and Amazon S3 document storage
**Local LLMs:** Ollama for on-device inference (e.g., qwen2.5-coder)
**AI Automation:** Lecture transcription and AI summary pipelines, LLM-generated trade explanations
**LLM Assistants:** Claude and ChatGPT for rapid prototyping, debugging, backend development, and workflow automation
**Workflow Automation:** n8n
